new.text: 8.4.4 Dlt_TpTxConfirmation [SWS_Dlt_00756] Definition of callback function Dlt_TpTxConfirmation ⌈ Service Name Dlt_TpTxConfirmation Syntax void Dlt_TpTxConfirmation ( PduIdType id, Std_ReturnType result ) Service ID [hex] 0x48 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant id Identification of the transmitted I-PDU. Parameters (in) result E_OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_NOT_OK: Transmission of the PDU failed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This function is called after the I-PDU has been transmitted on its network, the result indicates whether the transmission was successful or not. Available via Dlt.h ⌋
